senses.gloss:
इज्य इज्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. यज्), a teacher; an
epithet of Bṛhaspati the teacher or Guru of the gods;
(आ), f. a sacrifice, making offerings to the gods or
manes; a gift, a donation; worship, reverence; meet-
ing, union; a cow; a bawd or procuress.
—इज्या-
शील, अस्, m. a frequent sacrificer.
